Vendored third-party source shipped with StOMP.

SQLite 3.46.1 amalgamation (sqlite-amalgamation-3460100)
  https://www.sqlite.org/download.html
  sqlite3.c, sqlite3.h, sqlite3ext.h
  Public domain. Compiled by CMake as the static library stomp-sqlite
  (SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1). Distro sqlite packages are not required.

libprojectM 4.1.2
  projectm/  — LGPL-2.1 (projectm/LICENSE.txt)
  Built as a shared library and packed next to the inner player.
  Do not static-link it.
